PLAINTIFF'S NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AS TO HIS RULE 72(a)
OBJECTIONS TO ECF NO. 84 AND ACCOMPANYING MOTION
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine gives notice under Local Civil Rule 7(J) that he waives oral
argument on Plaintiff's Rule 72(a) Objections to ECF No. 84 and Motion to Set Aside the
Amendment and Discovery Denials and for Coordinated Determination of the Pending Objections,
submitted concurrently with this Notice, including the request for interim relief contained in that
Motion, and requests that the Court determine those matters on the papers.
This waiver is limited to the objections, Motion, and interim application identified above. It
does not waive Plaintiff's pending request to restore oral argument on ECF Nos. 15 and 54 (ECF
No. 67 9 6(d)). It does not withdraw or modify any objection, request, or issue presented in ECF
Nos. 66, 67, 68, or 76, including the objections concerning the termination of oral argument and the
remote-appearance motion (ECF No. 41). It does not alter the Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument
as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76 submitted on October 12, 2026.
1

Date: October 13, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I hereby certify that on October 13, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Plaintiff's Notice of
Waiver of Oral Argument as to His Rule 72(a) Objections to ECF No. 84 and Accompanying
Motion, together with the accompanying Certification Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) and
Generative Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification, to the Clerk of Court for
filing through the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS).
I further certify that, upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission on the Court's Case
Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system, a Notice of Electronic Filing will be
transmitted to counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children,
Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc., who are registered users of that system and will be served
through that means.
Date: October 13, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
